Class Activity

java.lang.Object
model.activity.Activity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Identifiable
Direct Known Subclasses:
CleaningActivity, EnrichmentActivity, FeedingActivity
public abstract class Activity extends Object implements Identifiable
Represents an abstract activity that is associated with a habitat and managed by an employee. This class provides the basic structure for activities, including their ID, habitat, responsible employee, status, cost, and important dates such as registration, scheduling, and execution.
